verdicts.reason: A scrambles the message: the order reads PRAY / When Life Is Great / When Life Is Rough / PRAY. 'When Life Is Rough' is smaller and left-offset, the divider line is left alone at the bottom-left beside the rose, and the rose is cropped into a hard rectangle. B keeps the original reading order, the divider and the type hierarchy at a legible size. But the rose is cropped into a visible rectangle with its stem cut off, the text block is tight to the left edge while about 180 px of dead space sits to the right of the rose, and the two halves of the layout feel crammed together.
